reason: Review of Q173 receipts showed the historical DSX context ladder used per-context warmup at a 1M server window. The initial Q190 no-warmup Maya plan was methodologically mismatched, and a 1M-vs-262144 window would also bias throughput.
changes: Use default llama-benchy warmup once per context for both profiles.
Rerun DSX and Maya at the same 262144 server context; retain historical 1M-window DSX data as historical only.
Use common target contexts 32768, 65536, 131072, and 261888 tokens; the last leaves room for 30 template tokens plus 128 exact output tokens.
Use three measured 32K samples after one per-context warmup for both models; one measured sample at each larger context.

tokenizer.origin: existing Q173 official tokenizer artifact; no new download

Strict dominance required; if mixed/near-tied/uncertain, keep and document why.
